name: day-trader-india
description: The Day Trader skill pack, ported to India's NSE cash market

plugins.name: day-trader-india
plugins.description: Eleven Claude skills for intraday trading on the NSE: a chart scanner, a news monitor (NSE filings + headlines), an entry timer, an exit planner, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager, a budget manager with Indian charges, an order executor (paper by default, never without your yes), price alerts on the NSE clock, an earnings analyst and a bulk/block deals tracker.
